scripts.media:sync: npm run media:video:build && npm run media:build && node tools/media-dev-state.mjs --write
scripts.build:site: npm run build:vite && npm run site:postbuild
scripts.build:core: npm run typecheck && npm run build:site
scripts.build: npm run media:ensure && npm run typecheck && npm run build:site
scripts.site:postbuild: npm run cv:content:apply && node tools/generate-sitemap.mjs && node tools/check-site-meta.mjs && node tools/check-local-links.mjs
scripts.test: npm run media:ensure && npm run test:core
scripts.test:media: npm run media:sync && node --test "test/media-tools/*.test.mjs" && node tools/check-data-integrity.ts
scripts.verify:core: npm run typecheck && npm run test:core && npm run build:site && npm run test:e2e:all
scripts.verify: npm run media:sync && npm run verify:core
